svg.title: ADR-001: Run the daily coach as a scripted pipeline, not an autonomous agent
svg.desc: Trade-off matrix across five dimensions. Scripted pipeline: reliability strong, cost strong, streak safety strong, security strong, flexibility mixed. Autonomous agent: reliability weak, cost weak, streak safety weak, security mixed, flexibility strong. The pipeline wins 4 of 5.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
text.tspan: Run the daily coach as a scripted pipeline, not an autonomous agent

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

text.tspan: Every day at 05:30, unattended on a Mac: write five new questions, build the deck,
record five minutes on camera, upload privately to YouTube, and chase me until I
record. The daily streak must never break.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

text.tspan: Code runs the routine. Claude is called once a day for the one step that needs
judgment: writing the questions. Its output is schema- and novelty-checked, with a

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
text.tspan: Option A: pipeline + one LLM call
launchd starts Python at 05:30. Code builds the deck, drives
QuickTime and PowerPoint, and calls the YouTube and
Calendar APIs. claude -p writes the questions.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

text.tspan: A scheduled Claude agent with shell, file, API and
computer-use tools runs the whole routine from a goal prompt,
deciding each step as it goes.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

text.tspan: Result: A wins 4 of 5 dimensions, B wins 1. Decision: adopt A.

About one model call a day
The streak survives model, network and upload outages
Credentials are used only by reviewed code paths

About 3,500 lines of Python and 35 automated tests to
Only the questions adapt; everything else is fixed until

The routine starts changing every week

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
text.tspan: Principle: agentic at build time, deterministic at run time.
Claude Code designed, built, tested and debugged this pipeline. At 05:30 the system makes one bounded model call and no agent decisions.
